title: Yu Special Isomorphism
body_html:
Yu Special Isomorphism

For a good element \(\Gamma\) and the associated pair \(J\supset J_+\), the quotient \[ W=J/J_+ \] is a finite symplectic vector space. Via the exponential map and the trace pairing, the canonical special morphism is \[ \zeta:J\to H(W),\qquad \exp(X)\mapsto (\bar X,B(X,\Gamma)). \] It extends to a morphism from \(G_x^0\ltimes J\) to the finite Heisenberg-Weil group \(Sp(W)\ltimes H(W)\).
proof_html: Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff shows that the second coordinate \(B(X,\Gamma)\) supplies exactly the central cocycle term. Agreement with Yu's root-theoretic special isomorphism follows because the two maps agree on the root subgroups.
